actions.action: Move plants to shade or bright indirect light for 3-5 days
Check top 1-2 cm of soil with finger and water only if dry
Cover pot with a perforated clear plastic bag as a mini greenhouse
Remove the plastic bag for a few hours daily and put it back
Watch over 3-7 days whether stems straighten
Change the water in the glass for the cuttings regularly, keeping only stem bases submerged and free of soil debris
Replant water-rooted cuttings into a small pot of light moist potting mix once roots reach 2-3 cm
Inspect stem bases for browning, blackening or softening (damping off)
If damping off appears, cut back watering and improve air circulation/ventilate the plastic cover more

reason: The answer correctly names transplant shock as the main cause, but its main advice is soil-based recovery, with keeping the basil in water only as a secondary note; nothing it suggests is harmful.
